categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Xiangyuan New Material Technology Inc. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polyolefin foam materials (IXPE and IXPP), polyurethane foam materials, silicone rubber, and supercritical foam materials. The company focuses on high-end applications in consumer electronics, automotive interiors, building decoration, and new energy vehicle materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes electronic irradiation cross-linking technology for polyethylene (IXPE) and polypropylene (IXPP) foam materials, enabling high rebound, corrosion resistance, and fine molding. It has proprietary equipment for granulation, extrusion, irradiation, and foaming processes, with over 80 patents including 54 invention patents. Advanced production methods include supercritical foaming and environmentally friendly silicone foam technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets), automotive (Ford, Changan, Great Wall), building and decoration (PVC flooring), and new energy vehicles (battery thermal management). The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant exports to the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and emerging sectors like aerospace and energy storage.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover China’s East, South, and Central regions, with production bases and subsidiaries in Anhui, Guangdong, Hubei, as well as overseas in Thailand, Vietnam, and Singapore. Export markets include North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia, accounting for nearly 29% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiangyuan New Material operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing advanced polymer foam materials that are supplied to downstream manufacturers of electronics, automotive parts, building materials, and new energy vehicle components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance, environmentally friendly, and composite foam materials. R&D focuses include ultra-thin IXPE materials, flame-retardant polyurethane foams for battery safety, silicone foam with ceramic properties for thermal insulation, and halogen-free flame retardant systems. It also invests in expanding production capacity and developing new applications in aerospace, medical devices, and sports equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of foam material products, including IXPE, IXPP, polyurethane, and silicone foam materials. The company uses a direct sales model predominantly, supplemented by limited distribution channels, with export sales contributing significantly to total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiangyuan New Material holds a leading position domestically in the polyolefin foam industry, especially in high-end applications where it competes with foreign suppliers. It has broken foreign monopolies in ultra-thin IXPE and IXPP materials and is expanding its footprint in new energy vehicle materials, positioning itself as a key domestic alternative to imported products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 475.9 million, a 24% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 25.6 million, down 37.65%. Total assets stood at RMB 1.56 billion with equity of RMB 1.40 billion, reflecting a solid asset base and ongoing investment in capacity expansion. The company faces profitability pressure but maintains growth in sales volume and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiangyuan New Material differentiates itself through advanced irradiation cross-linking technology, enabling production of ultra-thin, high-performance foam materials with superior rebound, insulation, and flame retardancy. Its proprietary equipment and extensive patent portfolio support product quality and innovation. The company emphasizes green, low-VOC materials and customized solutions for demanding applications in electronics, automotive, and new energy sectors, offering domestic alternatives to imported high-end products.
